nuggets.text: The Scarlet Knights won the first intercollegiate football game, 6-4 over Princeton on Nov. 6, 1869.
The Scarlet Knights' 1869 ancestors wore scarlet kerchiefs on their heads so the two teams could be told apart.
Before they were the Scarlet Knights, Rutgers teams were the Queensmen, a nod to the school's charter name, Queen's College.
The Scarlet Knights celebrate touchdowns and wins with a cannon blast.
Before home games, the Scarlet Knights make the Scarlet Walk and touch the First Game statue honoring 1869.
Scarlet Knights coach Greg Schiano once proposed doing away with kickoffs and replacing them with a punt.
Scarlet Knights WR KJ Duff, all 6-foot-6 of him, racked up 196 yards and three touchdowns in the opener.
Scarlet Knights WR KJ Duff's 241 receiving yards against Purdue in 2025 rank second in program history for one game.
Scarlet Knights QB Dylan Lonergan began at Alabama and started nine games for Boston College last fall before moving to Rutgers.
The Scarlet Knights honor 37 alumni lost on 9/11 with the number 37 on their helmets for this game.
